name: Sun Empire
description: The Sun Empire is a dinosaur-riding human empire of Ixalan, made up of four city-states, whose warriors cooperate with dinosaurs and are protected by sun priests.

description_citations.text: "Sun Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: The Sun Empire is a dinosaur-riding human empire of Ixalan, made up of four city-states, whose warriors cooperate with dinosaurs and are protected by sun priests.

citations.text: "Sun Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Dinosaur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Chacanto Intli founded the empire from Orazca, uniting the city-states, and its people descend from Komon Winaq who migrated to the surface while those who stayed became the Oltec.

citations.text: "Sun Empire", section "Early history". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ixalan (plane)", section "First Exodus". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The empire built Orazca around the Immortal Sun until an emperor misused it, and Azor made the Empire leave the hidden city.

citations.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Sun Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: A devastating war with the River Heralds under Apatzec Intli I reduced the empire to a few coastal cities and cost it Orazca.

citations.text: "Sun Empire", section "Early history". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ixalan (continent)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Besieged by Brazen Coalition raids and the Legion of Dusk, the empire retook Orazca, pushed the Legion back to the sea and prepared an invasion of Torrezon.

citations.text: "Sun Empire", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sun Empire", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

bio.text: In the New Phyrexian Invasion sleeper agents assassinated the emperor and ruined cities, and Phyrexian forces besieged the capital Pachatupa.

citations.text: "Sleeper agent", section "Created Sleeper Agents". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sun Empire", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Pachatupa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The Sun Empire then joined forces with the Legion of Dusk and pirates, and Zacama felled Etali.

citations.text: "Sun Empire", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ixalan (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: After the invasion Orazca was revived and declared the new capital.

citations.text: "Sun Empire", section "Rebuilding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Pachatupa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Later, a Sun Empire party led by Huatli reached the Core, and the empire's forces defeated Aclazotz's minions.

citations.text: "Amalia Benavides Aguirre", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Aclazotz", section "Freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: A second Dawn Fleet was built, and Beckett Brass forced a meeting of Sun Empire and Legion of Dusk factions to back a free pirate nation.

citations.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Rediscovery of the Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Beckett Brass", section "Governor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: As of the latest material the Sun Empire endures with Orazca as its capital, having survived the Phyrexian invasion and accepted a pirate Coalition state under Governor Brass.

citations.text: "Sun Empire", section "Rebuilding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ixalan (plane)", section "Rediscovery of the Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Stormwreck Sea", section "New Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Spurned by the Sun Empire, the refugee flotilla scatters across the Stormwreck Sea and turns to piracy, raiding Ixalan's coast.
timeline.quote: this refugee flotilla turned to piracy

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brass declares the age of piracy over and forces a meeting of Sun Empire and Legion of Dusk factions to support a free pirate nation, declaring herself Governor.
timeline.quote: declared the age of piracy to be over

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "After the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Saheeli Rai teaches Sun Empire engineers to build dozens of mechanical dinosaurs for the invasion of Torrezon.
timeline.quote: Saheeli Rai taught Sun Empire engineers to produce dozens of mechanical dinosaurs

citation.text: "Dinosaur", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Huatli rises to a station just short of nobility through her skill at sword, magic and controlling dinosaurs.
timeline.quote: Huatli rose to a station just short of nobility

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Early Career". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire builds Orazca around the Immortal Sun until an emperor misuses it, and Azor makes the Empire leave the hidden city.
timeline.quote: As a consequence, Azor caused the Empire to leave the city.

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Sun Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire and River Heralds are met by the Legion of Dusk and the Brazen Coalition as all race for Orazca's secret.
timeline.quote: The dinosaur -riding warriors of the Sun Empire and the merfolk shamans of the rival River Heralds are met by the vampire conquistadores of the Legion of Dusk and the pirates of the Brazen Coalition .

citation.text: "Ixalan", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire abuses the Immortal Sun's power, fracturing its balance with the River Heralds and pushing the empire toward the coasts.
timeline.quote: until its abuse of the artifact’s power fractured that balance

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A prolonged war with the River Heralds causes Azcanta to sink beneath the ocean.
timeline.quote: swallowed by the ocean during a war with the River Heralds

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk crosses the seas seeking the Immortal Sun and the city of gold, building forts and clashing with the Sun Empire, River Heralds and pirates.
timeline.quote: crossed the seas in search of the Immortal Sun and the fabled city of gold

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire takes Orazca and pushes the Legion of Dusk to the sea; Fort Leor falls.
timeline.quote: After the Sun Empire took Orazca and pushed the Legion of Dusk to the sea

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "Locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the invasion the Sun Empire moves its capital back to Orazca and begins a campaign to invade Torrezon using reverse-engineered ships.
timeline.quote: the Sun Empire moved its capital back to Orazca

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of thousands of Komon Winaq migrate to the surface, later becoming the Sun Empire, while those who stay become the Oltec.
timeline.quote: Those who stayed behind began to call themselves Oltec .

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "First Exodus". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Apatzec Intli I uses the Immortal Sun without restraint in a devastating war with the River Heralds.
timeline.quote: who had gained possession of the Immortal Sun and used it without restraint

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire retakes Orazca and pushes the Legion of Dusk back, then launches the Dawn Fleet toward Torrezon.
timeline.quote: the Sun Empire pushed the Legion of Dusk back to the sea

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orazca becomes the new heart of the Sun Empire and its population explodes.
timeline.quote: Its population exploded as migrants from across the empire streamed into the ancient metropolis

citation.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk conquers Torrezon; refugees refused harbor by the Sun Empire turn to raiding at sea.
timeline.quote: The Stormwreck Sea became a haven for outcasts when the Legion of Dusk conquered Torrezon around 98 BD .

citation.text: "Stormwreck Sea", section "Early Days". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chacanto Intli founds the Sun Empire from Orazca, uniting the city-states.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire was first founded from Orazca by Chacanto Intli

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Early history". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A devastating war with the River Heralds under Apatzec Intli I reduces the empire to a few coastal cities and costs it Orazca.
timeline.quote: Following a devastating war with the River Heralds under Apatzec Intli I

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Early history". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The empire, besieged by Brazen Coalition raids and the Legion of Dusk, rises to fight off its enemies.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire was besieged by pirate raids by the Brazen Coalition and the advance of the Legion of Dusk

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Orazca retaken, the empire pushes the Legion of Dusk back to the sea and prepares an invasion of Torrezon.
timeline.quote: With Orazca retaken, the Sun Empire pushed the Legion of Dusk back to the sea

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Facing the New Phyrexian Invasion, the Sun Empire joins forces with the Legion of Dusk.
timeline.quote: the Sun Empire was forced to join forces with the Legion of Dusk to defend the plane.

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As an eight-year-old, Huatli asks a priest what is on the far side of the sun and is told it doesn't matter (flashback).
timeline.quote: What's on the far side of the sun?

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The priest explains the duty of a warrior-poet to tell others' truths (flashback).
timeline.quote: It means that when you tell stories, you are telling someone's truth.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli tells Angrath her emperor sent her to find Orazca.
timeline.quote: My emperor tasked me with this.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath calls every group on Ixalan ants on an anthill.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire are ants on an anthill, and so are the River Heralds and so is Torrezon and so is every other group of idiots on this plane.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli senses Emperor Apatzec's army at the city's edge, realizing she was not sent alone.
timeline.quote: she felt the footsteps of Emperor Apatzec's army.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor explains he gave the Immortal Sun to a monastery in Torrezon and then to others who proved unworthy.
timeline.quote: I initially gifted it to a monastery in the east, in Torrezon.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor gifts the Immortal Sun to a monastery and then to the Sun Empire, reclaiming it each time.
timeline.quote: He gifted the Immortal Sun to a monastery that would later give rise to the Legion of Dusk

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli says Orazca belongs to no one and should be shared.
timeline.quote: Orazca belongs to no one,

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Apatzec enters Orazca at the head of a procession.
timeline.quote: The trees gave way to pillars of endless gold as they entered the city.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Apatzec declares Orazca the Sun Empire's again and names Torrezon as next.
timeline.quote: Ixalan is ours . . . and Torrezon is next.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana distrusts the Sun Empire under Emperor Apatzec III.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire was still ruled by Emperor Apatzec III, after all.

citation.work: Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings
authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Sun Empire priests tap something unexpected while digging a well.
timeline.quote: Sun Empire priests thought they were digging a well.

citation.text: Fountain of Ichor (Modern Horizons, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire repels the Legion's attempted conquest.
timeline.quote: The Legion's attempted conquest of the continent was repelled by the Sun Empire.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Age of Ever-Flowing Blood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion forces captured vampires to join the Sun Empire against it.
timeline.quote: However, before the war could continue, the New Phyrexian Invasion started, and the captured Mavren Fein's vampires had to join with the Sun Empire to defend the plane.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Age of Ever-Flowing Blood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Huatli leaves a lump of Sun Empire copper in a warded box with a note asking if R is a spy.
timeline.quote: Huatli places a medium-sized lump of Sun Empire copper inside

citation.text: "Note for a Stranger" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Fein returns to Ixalan, is captured by the Sun Empire, and is released under Huatli's command to invoke the Elder Dinosaurs against the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: was captured by the Sun Empire

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian Hosts invade Ixalan's continent; tens of thousands are Phyrexianized, and Pachatupa holds thanks to Huatli's warning.
timeline.quote: Within days, tens of thousands of humans and regiments of dinosaurs were Phyrexianized.

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire, pirates and the Legion of Dusk unite and Zacama fells Etali, saving Ixalan from the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Etali was finally felled by Zacama after injuring Zetalpa

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orazca prepares for the Phyrexians and seals itself, but Phyrexian sleeper agents are trapped inside.
timeline.quote: By sealing itself in against exterior threats, the Sun Empire inadvertently trapped itself in with an unknown, terrifying, internal threat

citation.text: "Orazca", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian vanguard lands near Atzocan and overwhelms the unprepared defenders.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexian vanguard landed near Atzocan, surprising the Sun Empire and overwhelming the unprepared defenders.

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian forces sweep the outer cities and besiege the capital Pachatupa.
timeline.quote: encircling the capital and committing it to siege

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

era.label: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

timeline.summary: Sun Empire soldiers clearing a Phyrexian nest discover a grand ancient door sealed with shards, leading to the underground.
timeline.quote: discovered a grand, ancient door, sealed with great shards

citation.text: "Orazca", section "Restoration". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Saheeli enters the Sun Empire's employ building mechanoquetzacama for the boy-emperor.
timeline.quote: The emperor commissioned her to create more of these creations, providing her with every resource in his empire.

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "Omenpath era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The vampire abominations attack the Oltec bat riders and the great battle begins.
timeline.quote: The vampire abominations flew toward the Oltec force.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The second Sun Empire delegation reaches Oteclan to find Chimil restored while pyres burn.
timeline.quote: The second Sun Empire delegation reached Oteclan a week after the battle, to find Chimil restored to her previous glory even as pyres of the dead burned.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz flies to Chimil to snuff it out, but his minions are defeated by the Sun Empire.
timeline.quote: However, they were defeated by the forces of the Sun Empire present in the Core.

citation.text: "Aclazotz", section "Freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brass crashes a Sun Empire and Legion of Dusk meeting and forces support for a free pirate nation, declaring herself Governor.
timeline.quote: declaring herself Governor

citation.text: "Beckett Brass", section "Governor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk frees Aclazotz, who tries to snuff out the inner sun, while the Mycotyrant attacks the Oltec; both are defeated but escape to the surface.
timeline.quote: The latter faction freed Aclazotz , who then attempted to snuff out the plane's inner sun.

citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk frees Aclazotz, who tries to snuff out the inner sun, while the Mycotyrant attacks the Oltec; both are defeated but escape to the surface.
timeline.quote: The latter faction freed Aclazotz, who then attempted to snuff out the plane's inner sun.

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Rediscovery of the Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire builds a second Dawn Fleet and Admiral Beckett Brass crashes a meeting, agreeing to support both factions for a Coalition state.
timeline.quote: Admiral Beckett Brass crashed a meeting of the two factions

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Rediscovery of the Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Some Komon Winaq go to the surface and become the Sun Empire; those who stay become the Oltec.
timeline.quote: Some of the Komon Winaq traveled to the plane's surface, later becoming the Sun Empire.

citation.text: "Oltec", section "The Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Contact between the Oltec and Sun Empire is sealed off because of the spread of the mycoids.
timeline.quote: They maintained regular trade with the Oltec until the spread of the mycoids forced the two to seal off contact.

citation.text: "Oltec", section "The Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kellan joins the party and the vampires talk their way into the Core with Sun Empire soldiers and River Heralds.
timeline.quote: The vampires convinced the party to bring them along into the Core

citation.text: "Queen's Bay Company", section "To Ixalan's Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The vampires break out and free Aclazotz, who turns them into demons; the armies clash, the vampires are defeated, and Aclazotz flees the Core.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz was released and turned the vampires into powerful demons under his control

citation.text: "Quintorius", section "On Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Without a unifying sacred site, the River Heralds' unity shatters and many resort to raids or serve other powers.
timeline.quote: Without a unifying sacred site, the River Heralds' fragile unity shattered.

citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Matzalantli". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Beckett Brass declares the age of piracy over, makes the Coalition a legitimate nation and becomes its first Governor.
timeline.quote: Beckett Brass declared the age of piracy over

citation.text: "Stormwreck Sea", section "New Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the invasion Orazca is revived and declared the new capital and refuge for the displaced.
timeline.quote: Orazca was revived and declared the new capital

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Rebuilding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An ancient civilization uses Chimil's magic to grow in power.
timeline.quote: An ancient civilization , ancestors of the Sun Empire , uses the magic of Chimil to grow in power.

citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Core a Sun Empire party led by Huatli appears and the vampires are imprisoned, but all except Amalia break out to free Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: all besides Amalia broke out to pursue Vito's goal

citation.text: "Amalia Benavides Aguirre", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Intli succeeds his long-lived mother and launches the empire into a renaissance and turmoil.
timeline.quote: launching the empire into a renaissance state

citation.text: "Apatzec Intli III", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Orazca is captured, Intli pushes the invaders to the sea and captures their fleet to prepare invading Torrezon.
timeline.quote: Apatzec began a campaign that pushed the invaders to the sea

citation.text: "Apatzec Intli III", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Pachatupa fills with refugees and peasant levies and the emperor's guards fight the Phyrexian horde; the city survives.
timeline.quote: Pachatupa — and to an extent, the Sun Empire — survived the invasion.

citation.text: "Pachatupa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the invasion the emperor returns the throne to Orazca, moving the capital.
timeline.quote: The emperor returned the throne to Orazca, the first capital of the Sun Empire

citation.text: "Pachatupa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun's removal shatters Ixalan's planar seal; the Legion retreats, the Coalition scatters and the Sun Empire reclaims Orazca.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire, led by Apatzec Intli III , reclaimed Orazca

citation.text: "Rediscovery of Orazca", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, entrances to the Core are discovered and factions converge on Matzalantli.
timeline.quote: entrances to the plane's Core were discovered across the surface of Ixalan

citation.text: "Reopening of Ixalan's Core", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: New Phyrexia uses sleeper agents in the invasion, assassinating the emperor and ruining Sun Empire cities.
timeline.quote: assassinating the emperor and causing ruin to many of the Sun Empire 's cities

citation.text: "Sleeper agent", section "Created Sleeper Agents". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the outbreak of the invasion Wayta lies about her age to join the Sun Empire forces and loses her left eye in Tocatli.
timeline.quote: she lied about her age to join the Sun Empire forces in defense of her plane

citation.text: "Wayta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: —Mahuiz, Sun Empire archer
